title: Informer: Beyond Efficient Transformer for Long Sequence Time-Series Forecasting
grouping: No containers: one horizontal chain from the input token stack through embedding, three attention blocks with conv/pool layers between them, to a small output feature map; each part is named in bold below it.
shapes_depth: Everything is drawn in 3-D perspective: the input is a stack of thin green slices split into 'Scalar' and 'Stamp' rows spanning T = t to T = t + D_x; dashed projection lines fan from it to two long bars (blue Conv1d, grey Embedding, each d × L) summed at a green sphere with a plus. Each attention block is a translucent beige box holding several red head slabs (n-heads, k), followed by blue and cyan slabs for Conv1d and MaxPool1d with 'padding=2' written diagonally along them. Block sizes shrink from L to L/2 to L/4, and those dimension labels are written along the boxes' edges; the output is a small purple box 'Feature Map' (d × L/4). Teal arrows connect stages.
proposed_highlight: The distilling operation is the subject: the conv/pool slabs between attention blocks are the only blue/cyan elements, and their effect is shown by the shrinking size of the next block.
lesson: Show sequence-length halving by drawing each successive attention block as a smaller 3-D box with L, L/2, L/4 written on its length edge, so the distilling is read from the geometry before any label.
notes: Venue from Semantic Scholar (AAAI); year = arXiv preprint year (2012.07436).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: self-attention distilling in a time-series encoder

core.what: one left-to-right chain of 3-D blocks whose attention blocks shrink in size (L, L/2, L/4) with Conv1d/MaxPool slabs between them, ending in a small purple Feature Map

relations.form: teal arrows run strictly left to right: input window -> embedding -> Attention Block 1 -> Conv1d/MaxPool -> Attention Block 2 -> Conv1d/MaxPool -> Attention Block 3 -> Feature Map
three beige translucent attention blocks of the same form, each holding red head slices, drawn successively smaller with the length printed on each (L, L/2, L/4)
the green input slab (T = t to T = t + D_x) splits into Scalar and Stamp; dashed projection lines lead to a blue and a grey embedding slab whose outputs meet at a green ⊕ node

channels.colour: green = input window, blue/grey = scalar/stamp embeddings, beige = attention block, red = attention heads, blue/cyan = Conv1d/MaxPool outputs, purple = feature map
channels.shape: 3-D slab size = tensor size (length shrinks block to block), slices inside a block = heads
channels.line: teal solid arrows = data flow, dashed black = projection from the input window
channels.frame: each translucent beige box = one attention block

quality.strengths: The distilling halving is geometry: each attention block is visibly smaller than the one before, so the L -> L/2 -> L/4 reduction reads without labels; the path is one straight left-to-right line.
quality.weaknesses: Rotated 'MaxPool1d, padding=2' labels and dimension letters (L/2, d, k) overlap the slabs and each other; heavy 3-D boxes with stacked red slices make the attention blocks the most saturated elements although the conv distilling between them is the contribution; dimension symbols carry meaning only with the text.

insights.structure: One left-to-right chain of 3-D blocks: input embedding (scalar + stamp) -> Attention Block 1 -> Conv1d/MaxPool -> Attention Block 2 -> Conv1d/MaxPool -> Attention Block 3 -> Feature Map.
insights.data: The input window is a green slab of cells labelled T = t to T = t + D_x split into Scalar and Stamp; attention blocks are beige translucent boxes holding red head slices; Conv1d outputs are thin blue/cyan slabs; dimensions L, L/2, L/4, d, k, n-heads are written on edges.
insights.emphasis: The shrinking size of successive attention blocks (L -> L/2 -> L/4) makes the distilling halving visible without text.
insights.flow: Strictly left to right along teal arrows; dashed projection lines fan from the input slab into the embedding bars.
insights.avoid: Rotated dimension labels overlap the slabs ('MaxPool1d, padding=2' collides with L/2), and the dense 3-D perspective is heavy for what is a 1-D sequence.

arrangement.units: one pipeline of 3-D blocks, each block labelled underneath in bold, no enclosing frames
arrangement.inputs_as: a 3-D slab of time-step cells with scalar and timestamp rows
